description: All channels for a model sorted by input price, with the difference versus the official list price. List prices as published by each channel at observed_at, USD per 1M tokens unless stated; China-site price lists are in CNY, listed separately and never converted. Standard (on-demand) plan unless service_plan says otherwise. The channel's own page is authoritative. Aggregator prices are the marketplace's own and never the reference. A missing price is unknown, not free. Not purchasing advice.

model.description: Model id such as openai/gpt-6.1-sol, or an alias the channels use (gpt-6.1-sol, claude-opus-5-5). Case-insensitive.

name: compare_channels
title: Compare channels for one model
